findings: The supplied original is a99-page revision whose physical74–75 are cover plans, not structure-header sheets. Physical41 contains a count row, not a two-stop geometric description.

The explicit layer detail is on physical76; its scopes are street, exits, widening trench, technical and pedestrian sidewalks, and tramway. No explicitly named stop/boarding-platform pavement structure was found there.
Original schedule does confirm stop presence and curb intervals but does not supply the requested base-sublayer areas or boarding-platform148m².
This is a source/scope gap for the requested six work quantities; no evidence supports replacing the missing facts with numerically similar rows for another construction.
limits: No production changes. No RouterAI, network, model pilots or103 run.
No quantities selected by VOR coincidence, no area inferred from an unlabelled curb line, no splitting thickness into construction layers treated as a project quote.
This audit establishes missing verified scope within the inspected original; it does not prove all six VOR quantities wrong.
Prepared/OCR source revision and physical page mapping should be checked independently before adding any corpus patch.
